_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings for sessions Herald runs. `herald ext sync` writes .claude/settings.json from this file plus every enabled extension's hooks/hooks.json, so edit this rather than the generated file.
_hooks_comment: PreToolUse runs tools/guard.py before every Bash and connector call: it blocks a runtime script or connector that would write to Google outside gwrite.py or red.py. Matched narrowly on purpose, because this runs before every matching call and latency is round trips; Read, Write and Edit cannot execute anything.
